finding_verdicts.reason: SKILL.md line 14 uses Markdown backticks for skill and CLI names, not Ruby or shell execution. The complete file contains no executable command block or instruction to run these names.
SKILL.md line 6 declares a GitHub repository homepage in frontmatter. It does not request a network operation or transmit data.

SKILL.md line 14 links to a fixed sibling skill document as a migration pointer. No user-controlled path, sensitive file target, or filesystem write appears; the successor contents remain outside this review.

content.value_statement: Existing cargo-cdk installations can retain an outdated skill name after a rename. This migration pointer identifies cargo-project as the replacement and documents the CLI naming change.
actual_capabilities: Identifies cargo-project as the replacement skill for cargo-cdk.
Provides a relative link to the cargo-project skill entrypoint.
Documents the rename from cargo-ai cdk to cargo-ai project.
States that cdk remains a CLI alias.
Explains that this redirect is planned for removal in a later release.
limitations: Contains no operational project instructions or executable tooling.
The successor skill is not included in the supplied files.
Requires @cargo-ai/cli according to the declared compatibility metadata.
Does not specify a removal date or verify alias behavior in installed CLI versions.
